name: Status Extension Notification V 03
definition: Scope|The StatusExtensionNotification message is sent by the matching application to the parties involved in a request to extend the status of a transaction.|This message is used to inform about the acceptance of a request to extend the status of a transaction.|Usage|The StatusExtensionNotification message can be sent by the matching application|- to the submitter of a request to extend the status of a transaction to pass on information about the acceptance of the request that it has obtained through the receipt of an StatusExtensionAcceptance message.|- to the accepter of a request to extend the status of a transaction to inform about the actual status of the transaction in response to a StatusExtensionAcceptance message.|In order to pass on information about the rejection of a request to extend the status of a transaction the matching application sends a StatusExtensionRejectionNotification message.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.|.

EstablishedBaselineIdentification.name: Established Baseline Identification
EstablishedBaselineIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the baseline when it is established.

UserTransactionReference.name: User Transaction Reference
UserTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for each financial institution which is a party to the transaction.

ExtendedStatus.name: Extended Status
ExtendedStatus.definition: Identifies the status that is being rolled over.

RequestForAction.name: Request For Action
RequestForAction.definition: Information on the next processing step required.
